_source: Bee Swarm Simulator Wiki (Robo Bear, Robo Bear Challenge, Cog pages) + gamerjournalist.com round list, fetched 2026-11-26. Upgrades are generated by tools/build_rules.py; edit the table there, not here. Updated 2026-11-26 from the BSS wiki pages Robo Bear Challenge, Mechsquito, Mega Mechsquito, Cogmower, Golden Cogmower, Cogturret, Drives, Digital Bee.
_unknown: Not published anywhere: upgrade Cog prices, reroll prices, bonus-Cog amounts, debuff scaling. The agent reads prices from the shop UI with OCR instead.

challenge.fail_condition: any round not completed within the time limit ends the challenge
challenge.leave_between_rounds: allowed; leaving during a round ends the challenge
challenge.debuff_note: starts strong and weakens each round; no published formula
challenge._fast_bonus_note: Round Speed Bonus is paid if the quest is done within 3:45, proportional to speed
challenge_ends_if: player hatches or transforms a bee (Star Treat is OK)

round_flow.detail: choose 1 of 2 random quests; harder quests pay more Cogs; one free reroll per run
pick from a random selection of your bees (3 in round 1, then +2 per round); rerolls cost Cogs and get more expensive
buy upgrades with Cogs; LOCK unaffordable ones to keep them for later rounds (locks survive rerolls)
complete the quest within 5 minutes while Robo Bear's mobs attack

10._note: 4 + 3 + 3 cogmowers, one field from each set; they stay in their field

20._note: 4 sets of 5 cogmowers, nearly the same fields as round 10 plus Rose Field

objective_patterns._about: Matched against quest text read by OCR (lower case, lines joined). Several entries may share an id. Named groups: amount, color, place, mob. 'pollen' is spelled loosely because OCR sometimes reads it as 'potten'.

objective_patterns._verify: wording with a field not seen on screen yet

objective_patterns._note: wiki: avoid unless blue hive or small target

objective_patterns._verify: wording not seen on screen yet
wording not seen on screen yet

Mechsquito.behaviour: spawns far away, flies close, hovers away; stops, aims a few seconds, fires an exploding projectile at where you ARE
Mechsquito.debuff: Mechsquito Toxin: lower pollen + move speed, stacks to 10
Mechsquito.dodge: keep moving in circles; it aims at your current position, not where you will be
Mechsquito.kill: stand near it so bees lock on

Mega Mechsquito.behaviour: like Mechsquito but stays farther away and fires 6 projectiles in quick succession
Mega Mechsquito.dodge: keep moving in circles; dangerous to a player standing still

Cogmower.behaviour: rises from the field, drives in straight lines, bounces off edges and other cogmowers, drains flowers; follows you to new fields
Cogmower.dodge: doesn't aim at you; sidestep its line
Cogmower.kill: hitbox is in front of it; stand near so bees lock on

Golden Cogmower.behaviour: like Cogmower but stays in its field until the round ends
Golden Cogmower.tip: after the round starts, check those fields (Red Cannon) and kill it for Cogs

Cogturret.behaviour: hides under the field edge (untargetable), rises, waits a few seconds, fires a giant cog straight ahead (forward/left/right/back) that wipes flowers, then hides again
Cogturret.dodge: don't stand in front of it; step sideways after it rises
Cogturret.tip: kill them early before they pile up; stand near so bees target them

white.effects: x1.25 White Pollen, x1.25 White Field Capacity, +1 Colorless Bee Attack

red.effects: x1.25 Red Pollen, x1.25 Red Field Capacity, +1 Red Bee Attack

blue.effects: x1.25 Blue Pollen, x1.25 Blue Field Capacity, +1 Blue Bee Attack

glitched.effects: x1.25 Pollen, x1.25 Field Capacity, +1 Bee Attack

drives._note: bought in Robo Bear's Shop; each use lasts one round. With Digital Bee active, using a drive also corrupts your field and permanently enhances Digital Bee (Drive Expansion passive)
drives._n: n = how many of that drive you have bought (honey price grows fast)

effects.text: Focus tokens grant x1.03 Pollen from Tools and Collector Tool Speed for 20s (stacks 10x)
Blue Boost tokens grant x1.03 Attack and x1.03 Blue Bee Attack for 15s (stacks 10x)
All Ability Tokens can be created During Battle
Mark tokens grant x1.03 Critical Power for 15s (stacks 10x)
Bubbles collect x4 from Red Flowers, Flames collect x4 from Blue Flowers
Haste tokens grant +2% Dodge Chance for 20s (stacks 10x)
Red Bomb Sync always active with Crimson Bee, Blue with Cobalt Bee

quest_tips: avoid 'Convert at Hive' unless blue hive or small amount
save quest rerolls; Reboot upgrade gives one more
finish fast: mobs pile up as the round drags on
